text:
Ian Szabo’s knack for turning raw data into actionable insights became clear during a project where he reengineered our customer segmentation model. Faced with a 40% slowdown in query response times, he dissected our SQL workflows, identifying a redundant join operation that was costing hours daily. By restructuring the query and indexing key columns, he slashed processing time by 70%, enabling real-time analytics for our sales team. This attention to efficiency wasn’t just technical—it reflected a curiosity about how systems interact that propelled him to dig deeper than most.  

As NexaCorp’s Senior Data Scientist, Ian balances technical rigor with a collaborative spirit. His Python scripts for automating data pipelines reduced manual overhead, while his Jupyter notebooks—brimming with visualizations using Plotly—made complex trends accessible to non-technical stakeholders. He once spent weeks refining a hypothesis about user churn, iterating models with scikit-learn and TensorFlow until the results aligned with business goals. What stands out is his patience; he’ll spend hours debugging a query or tuning a model, always prioritizing precision over speed.  

Beyond skills, Ian’s work ethic is unshakable. He thrives in ambiguity, often volunteering to tackle edge cases others avoid. His SQL-driven analytics have directly influenced product roadmap decisions, quantifying the value of features in ways that resonate across teams.  

Ian’s combination of analytical depth and practical insight makes him a rare asset. I wholeheartedly recommend him for any role requiring both technical mastery and a knack for turning data into strategy.
